free_tier.stated: No published storage cap. Explicitly excluded from the per-project 10 GiB limit; unlimited container repositories per project is the practical reading.

egress.terms: Free, Cloudflare + Google Cloud CDN. Blob requests 307-redirect to cdn.registry.gitlab-static.net with a signed URL — directly cacheable by an external Cloudflare zone.

tooling: Standard OCI Distribution v2. ORAS, skopeo, crane, docker. Auth flow is anonymous for public projects (`/jwt/auth` returns a token with auth_type=none).
chaining: One OCI artifact per blob of any size -> unlimited projects x unlimited repositories x unlimited tags. This is the canonical 'OCI registry as object store' pattern (ORAS). Blob dedupe means the same chunk stored in N projects costs one copy but is addressable N times.
limits_note: Auth token TTL 15 min on GitLab.com. Blob size limited only by the registry (manifest layers routinely are 100s of MB; no documented per-layer cap). Renaming a project with >1000 container repos is blocked. Public pulls are rate-limited loosely; anonymous token issuance works but each pull needs a token round-trip.

identity_cost.detail: derived from the record's prose, not from an identity field, and no signup was executed: er repos is blocked. Public pulls are rate-limited loosely; anonymous token issuance works but each pull needs a token round-trip. registry

reliability_note: GitLab has run garbage-collection and cleanup-policy tooling against registries since 2023; no automatic purge is documented, but stale-tag cleanup policies are a first-class feature other users may set on shared projects. Own projects are not touched.
